sources.title: mazesmazes/tiny-audio · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Tiny Audio Efficient Speech Recognition with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Tiny Audio is a lightweight automatic speech recognition (ASR) model that combines a LoRA-adapted HuBERT-XLarge encoder with a LoRA-adapted SmolLM3-3B language model decoder, connected via a trainable audio projector.

sources.title: mazesmazes/tiny-audio-omni · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: How It Works Audio Encoder: GLM-ASR converts 16kHz audio into frame-level embeddings (768-dim) Projector: A 2-layer MLP with frame stacking bridges the audio and text embedding spaces Language Model: Qwen3 generates text autoregressively, conditioned on the projected audio
